Rashi on Pesachim 31b:10:1.hebrew: בשוגג - ששגג בתרומה, ואפילו הזיד בחמץ — משלם קרן וחומש. ואף על גב דלא הוה שויא מידי, דחמץ בפסח אסור בהנאה — מיהו שוגג דתרומה, דכתיב ביה: "וחמישיתו יוסף עליו ונתן לכהן את הקודש", דבר הראוי להיות קודש, שאינו יכול לשלם לו המעות אלא הפירות, והתשלומין נעשין תרומה כדלקמן — לאו לפי דמים משלם, אלא לפי מדה משלם. הלכך, לאו בתר דמים אזלינן:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:10:1.english: Unwittingly - [This means] that he acted unwittingly regarding [its being] teruma; and even if he acted intentionally regarding [its being] leaven, he pays the principal and a fifth. And even though it was not worth anything, as leaven on Passover is forbidden for benefit, nevertheless, [in the case of one who eats] teruma unwittingly — concerning which it is written: “And he shall add its fifth to it, and give the holy thing to the priest” (Leviticus 22:14), [meaning] something that is fit to become holy, for he cannot pay him money, but rather [only] produce, and the payment becomes teruma, as [explained] below — he does not pay according to [monetary] value, but rather he pays according to measure. Therefore, we do not follow monetary value.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:10:2.hebrew: במזיד - שהזיד בתרומה, אפילו שגג בחמץ — פטור מן התשלומין:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:10:2.english: Intentionally - Where he acted intentionally regarding the teruma, even if he acted unwittingly regarding the chametz — he is exempt from payment.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:10:3.hebrew: ומדמי עצים - אם תרומה טמאה היא, אין משלם לו דמי עצים שהיתה ראויה להיסק תחת תבשילו. משום דתרומה מזיד אין בה חומש, ואין תשלומיה לכפרה, ואין נעשין תרומה, דגבי חומש בשגגה כתיב. אבל מזיד אינו אלא כשאר גזלן בעלמא, ומשלם מעות, ולפי דמים ולא לפי המדה. וחמץ בפסח לאו בר דמים, דאסור בהנאה, ואף להיסק לא הוי חזי ליה, ולאו מידי אפסדיה:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:10:3.english: And from the value of wood - If it is ritually impure teruma, he does not pay him the value of wood [for] which it would have been fit as fuel under his cooked food. Because intentional [consumption of] teruma does not incur a fifth, its repayment is not for atonement, and [the payments] do not become teruma, for regarding the fifth, "in error" is written [in the verse]. Rather, an intentional [offender] is merely like any other ordinary robber, and pays money according to monetary value, and not according to measure. And leaven on Passover is not of monetary value, as it is forbidden to derive benefit [from it]; and it was not even fit for him for kindling, so he did not cause him any loss.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:1:1.hebrew: אלא - רישא וסיפא כשהרהינו, אבל בלא הרהינו — דכולי עלמא מכאן ולהבא הוא גובה:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:1:1.english: Rather - [Both] the first clause and the latter clause [deal with a case] where he deposited it [as collateral] with him; but without [having] deposited it, everyone agrees that he collects from now onwards.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:1:2.hebrew: קונה משכון - כל ימי הלואה, המשכון קנוי לו. ואם נאנס — חייב באונסין, שאינו עליו לא כשומר חנם ולא כשומר שכר, שפטורין באונסין, אלא כולו ברשותיה ובשמירתו עומד:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:1:2.english: Acquires collateral - Throughout the duration of the loan, the collateral is acquired by him. And if it suffers an unavoidable mishap, he is liable for unavoidable mishaps, for he is not [liable] for it like an unpaid bailee nor like a paid bailee, who are exempt from unavoidable mishaps, but rather it stands entirely in his domain and under his safekeeping.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:1:3.hebrew: ולך תהיה צדקה - בהשבת העבוט כתיב. אי אמרת קונה משכון — איכא צדקה בהא שכיבה ששכב בשמלתו, שהשאיל לו זה דבר הקנוי לו. ואם אינו קונה — צדקה בהשכבה זו מניין? על שלו שכב:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:1:3.english: And it shall be a righteousness for you - It is written regarding the return of the pledge. If you say [that the creditor] acquires the collateral, there is righteousness in this sleeping that [the debtor] slept in his garment, for this [creditor] lent him an item acquired by him. And if he does not acquire [it] — from where is [there] righteousness in this sleeping? He was sleeping on [what is] his own!

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:2:1.hebrew: אבל ישראל מנכרי לא - הלכך, לא עבר עליה, דאמר מר (לעיל פסחים דף כט.): ״אבל אתה רואה של אחרים״:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:2:1.english: However, a Jew [who takes collateral] from a gentile does not [acquire it] - Therefore, he did not violate [the prohibition] on its account, as the Master said (above, Pesachim 29a): “However, you may see [the leaven] of others.”

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:4:1.hebrew: תנן נכרי שהלוה וכו' - ואותיבנא לרבא לעיל, ושנינן: ״בשהרהינו אצלו״. והא אמרת השתא: דברי הכל נכרי מישראל לא קני:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:4:1.english: We learned: A gentile who lent, etc. - And we raised an objection against Rava earlier, and we answered: “Where he deposited it with him [as collateral].” But behold, you said just now: Everyone agrees that a gentile does not acquire [collateral] from a Jew:

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:4:2.hebrew: לא קשיא - מתניתין, דאמר ליה כשהרהינו אצלו: "אם לא אתן לך עד יום פלוני, יהא שלך מעכשיו". הלכך, נכרי שהלוה את ישראל — קם ליה חמץ ברשות נכרי, וישראל שהלוה את הנכרי — קם ליה ברשות ישראל. ברייתא, דלא אמר ליה "מעכשיו", אלא כשאר משכון נתנו לו, וקבע לו זמן שאם לא יפרע לו, יגבה חובו ממשכונו וישום אותו בדמים. הלכך, בנכרי שהלוה לישראל — דברי הכל, אפילו לא פרע ליה, אסור לישראל ליהנות ממנו, דכל ימות הפסח של ישראל היה, דמכאן ולהבא הוא גובה; ואי משום דהרהינו — נכרי מישראל לא קני. וישראל שהלוה — פליגי: מאן דאסר סבר, כיון שהרהינו, בעל חוב קונה משכון, וליכא למימר הכא מכאן ולהבא גובה; ומאן דשרי קסבר, ישראל מנכרי ליכא צדקה, ולא קני משכון:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:4:2.english: This is not difficult - Our Mishnah [deals with a case] where he said to him when he deposited it as collateral with him: "If I do not give [the money] to you by such-and-such a day, let it be yours from now." Therefore, [in the case of] a gentile who lent to a Jew, the leavened bread stood in the gentile's possession; and [in the case of] a Jew who lent to the gentile, it stood in the Jew's possession. The Baraita [deals with a case] where he did not say to him "from now," but rather gave it to him like any other collateral and set a time for him, such that if he does not repay him, he may collect his debt from his collateral and appraise it for value. Therefore, in [the case of] a gentile who lent to a Jew, all agree that even if he did not repay him, it is forbidden for a Jew to derive benefit from it, because throughout the days of Passover it belonged to the Jew, as he collects [it only] from this point onward; and if [one were to say that he acquired it] because he deposited it as collateral with him — a gentile does not acquire collateral from a Jew. And [in the case of] a Jew who lent [to a gentile], they disagree: the one who forbids holds that since he deposited it as collateral with him, a creditor acquires collateral, and one cannot say here that he collects [only] from this point onward; and the one who permits holds that [regarding] a Jew from a gentile, there is no [basis in the verse regarding] "righteousness," and [so] he does not acquire collateral.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:1.hebrew: ומנא תימרא - דאפילו כשהרהינו, שאני לן בין אמר מעכשיו ללא אמר מעכשיו:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:1.english: And from where do you say - That even when he pledged it [as collateral], we distinguish between [a case where] he said "from now" and [a case where] he did not say "from now".

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:2.hebrew: פת פורני - פת גדולה האפויה בתנור גדול, כעין תנורים שלנו, שהתנורים שלהם היו קטנים ומיטלטלין, ופיהם למעלה, ומדביקין הפת בדפנות, שאין אופין בה אלא פתים קטנים. ואורחא דמילתא נקט, דאיידי דחשיבי, שקיל ליה במשכון:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:2.english: Bread baked in an oven [pat purni] - A large loaf that is baked in a large oven, similar to our ovens; for their ovens were small and portable, and their opening was at the top, and they would stick the bread to the walls, such that one bakes in it only small loaves. And [the baraita] mentioned the common case, for since they are valuable, he takes it as collateral.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:3.hebrew: אינו עובר - בפסח, דקסבר: ישראל מנכרי לא קני משכון:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:3.english: He does not transgress - on Passover, for he holds [that] a Jew does not acquire collateral from a gentile.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:4.hebrew: הגעתיך - מעכשיו קאמר: ״אם לא אפרע לך עד יום פלוני״. ״עובר״ — ואף על פי שלא הגיע הזמן, שמא כשיגיע לא יפרע, ונמצא עובר למפרע בבל יראה:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:4.english: "I have made them yours" - He is saying: "[It is yours] from now if I do not repay you by such-and-such a day." [And that which was taught, "he] transgresses" — [this applies] even though the time [for repayment] has not [yet] arrived, lest when it arrives he does not repay, and he will turn out to have transgressed "it shall not be seen" retroactively.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:5.hebrew: מאי שנא רישא כו' - אי הגעתיך לאו מעכשיו הוא, מאי קא מהני? בלאו הגעתיך נמי, כי מטא זמניה ולא פרע, שקיל ליה בחובו:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:5:5.english: What is different in the first clause, etc. - If [saying] "I have made them yours" does not mean "from now," what does it accomplish? Even without [saying] "I have made them yours," when its due date arrives and he does not pay, he takes it for his debt!

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:6:1.english: And merchandise belonging to a Jew - Bread and wine sold in it.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:6:2.hebrew: אסור בהנאה - דלא תלינן ליה בפועלין, אלא מן של מלאי היה, ושל ישראל הוא:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:6:2.english: It is forbidden to derive benefit - For we do not attribute it to the workers; rather, it was from the stock, and it belongs to a Jew.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:8:1.hebrew: צריך שיבטל בלבו - שמא יפקח הגל במועד, ונמצא עובר עליו:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:8:1.english: He is required to nullify [it] in his heart - Lest the heap of rubble be cleared during the Festival, and he turn out to violate [the prohibition] on its account.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:9:1.hebrew: כספים - של פיקדון, אין להם שמירה אלא בקרקע. ואם לא נתנן בקרקע ואבדו — פשיעה היא אצלו וחייב, דשומר חנם חייב בפשיעה:
Rashi on Pesachim 31b:9:1.english: Money - [Money] of a deposit has no [effective] safeguarding except in the ground. And if he did not put it in the ground and it was lost, this is negligence on his part and he is liable, as an unpaid bailee is liable for negligence.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:9:2.english: Due to the smell - For a dog smells it, digs for it, and pulls it out.

Rashi on Pesachim 31b:9:3.english: From Sikhra - [The name of] a place.

Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:1:1.hebrew: אלא הב"ע שהרהינו אצלו וקמיפלגי בדרבי יצחק - תימה לריב"א: אביי היאך יתרץ הך? דע"כ בדרבי יצחק קמיפלגי! וסיפא דקתני "נכרי שהלוה את ישראל על חמצו", אמאי דברי הכל עובר? אע"ג דלא קנה — כיון דלמפרע הוא גובה! ורישא נמי, אמאי אינו עובר למ"ד — כיון דלמפרע הוא גובה? ומפרש ריב"א: דהשתא כי מוקי פלוגתא בדרבי יצחק, מיירי שלא בא ישראל לידי גבייה, שפדאו נכרי לבסוף, דלא שייך השתא פלוגתא דאביי ורבא כלל; אלא בהא קמיפלגי: דלמאן דאמר עובר ס"ל דקני ליה ישראל מנכרי, וה"ל ברשות ישראל, ומ"ד אינו עובר ס"ל דלא קני ליה, והרי לא היה ברשותו. ובסיפא, ד"ה עובר — דלא קני ליה נכרי לכ"ע, והרי היה ברשות ישראל. ומיהו מתניתין דקתני "נכרי שהלוה וכו' מותר בהנאה", מיירי שלא פדאו ישראל — דאי פדאו, אע"ג דמוקי לה בסמוך בדאמר ליה "מעכשיו", מכל מקום מאי מהני:
Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:1:1.english: "Rather, with what are we dealing here? Where he deposited [the collateral] with him, and they disagree with regard to [the statement of] Rabbi Yitzḥak" - The Riva raises a difficulty: How will Abaye resolve this [baraita]? For perforce they disagree with regard to [the statement of] Rabbi Yitzḥak. And [according to Abaye,] in the latter clause, which teaches: "A gentile who lent to a Jew on his leavened bread, [after Passover] everyone agrees he transgresses," why does everyone agree he transgresses? Even though [the gentile] did not acquire [the collateral under Rabbi Yitzḥak's rule], since one collects retroactively [according to Abaye, once the gentile forecloses on it, it belongs to the gentile retroactively from the time of the loan, so it was not the Jew's during Passover]! And in the first clause as well, why does he not transgress according to the one who said [he does not transgress], since one collects retroactively [so once the Jew collects it, retroactively it was the Jew's during Passover]? And the Riva explains: Now that [the Gemara] establishes the dispute as being about [the statement of] Rabbi Yitzḥak, it is dealing with a case where the Jew did not come to collect [the collateral], for the gentile redeemed it in the end. [Therefore,] the dispute between Abaye and Rava is not relevant here at all. Rather, they disagree about this: According to the one who says he transgresses, he holds that a Jew acquires [collateral] from a gentile [during the period it is held], and so it was in the Jew's possession; and the one who says he does not transgress holds that he does not acquire it [from a gentile], and behold, it was not in his possession. And in the latter clause, everyone agrees that he transgresses because a gentile does not acquire [collateral] from a Jew according to all, and behold, it was in the Jew's possession. However, our Mishnah, which teaches: "A gentile who lent [to a Jew on his leavened bread... after Passover] it is permitted to derive benefit," is dealing with a case where the Jew did not redeem it [and the gentile foreclosed on it]. For had he redeemed it, even though [the Gemara] establishes it shortly [as applying] where he said to him "from now," nevertheless, what would that avail?

Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:1:2.hebrew: בדרבי יצחק קמיפלגי - תימה: הא ר' יצחק לא קאמר דקני משכון אלא שלא בשעת הלואה, כדמוכח בהאומנין (בבא מציעא פב.)! והכא, "ישראל שהלוה לנכרי על חמצו" תנן, דמשמע בשעת הלואה — כדמשמע בהאומנין, דקתני: "הלוהו על המשכון שומר שכר", והתניא "שומר חנם", ומשני: הא דמשכנו בשעת הלואתו, והא שלא בשעת הלואתו; ופריך: והא אידי ואידי "על המשכון" קתני! ויש לומר, דהכי פירושו: כיון דשלא בשעת הלואה קונה לגמרי כדרבי יצחק, א"כ לענין חמץ יש לנו לחושבו כאילו הוא שלו, לעבור ב"לא ימצא" אף בשעת הלואה, דחשבינן ליה מצוי. וכן יש לפרש בהשולח (גיטין לז) גבי "המלוה על המשכון אינו משמט" מדרבי יצחק: כיון דקני ליה שלא בשעת הלואה, בשעת הלואה נמי מיקרי "של אחיך בידך":
Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:1:2.english: "They disagree with regard to [the statement] of Rabbi Yitzḥak" - [This is] puzzling: For Rabbi Yitzḥak said that [a creditor] acquires collateral only [when taken] not at the time of the loan, as is proven in [the chapter entitled] HaOmanin (Bava Metzia 82a)! And here we learned [in the Mishnah]: "A Jew who lent [money] to a gentile on his chametz," which implies [that the collateral was taken] at the time of the loan — as is implied in HaOmanin, where it teaches: "If he lent him [money] on collateral, [he is] a paid bailee," yet it was taught [in a baraita]: "[He is] an unpaid bailee," and [the Gemara there] answers: This [case is where] he took collateral from him at the time of his loan, and this [case is where he took it] not at the time of his loan; and [the Gemara] challenges: But both this [mishnah] and that [baraita] teach "on collateral"! And one can say that this is its explanation: Since [when collateral is taken] not at the time of the loan [the creditor] acquires it completely in accordance with Rabbi Yitzḥak, if so, regarding chametz we must consider it as though it is his, so that he violates [the prohibition of] "it shall not be found" even [when taken] at the time of the loan, for we consider it "found [with him]." And so too one can explain in [the chapter entitled] HaSholei'ach (Gittin 37a) regarding "One who lends on collateral, [the Sabbatical year] does not cancel [the debt]" [which is derived] from [the statement] of Rabbi Yitzḥak: Since he acquires it [when taken] not at the time of the loan, at the time of the loan as well it is called "[that which is] of your brother in your hand."

Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:1:3.hebrew: שקונה משכון - פ"ה: קונה משכון לענין חיוב אונסין. ור"י אומר: דבהאומנין (ב"מ פב.) משמע דלא הוי אלא שומר שכר, ד"הלוהו על המשכון שומר שכר" בעי למימר התם בגמרא דסבר לה כרבי יצחק. וכולה שמעתא, חמצו של נכרי ביד ישראל, איירי שלא קבל עליו ישראל אחריות; דאי קבל — הרי הוא שלו ועובר עליו, כדמוכח בפ"ק (דף ה:):
Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:1:3.english: That [a creditor] acquires collateral - The Kuntres explained: [A creditor] acquires the collateral with regard to liability for unavoidable accidents. And the Ri says that in [the chapter entitled] HaUmanin (Bava Metzia 82a), it implies that he is only a paid bailee, as the Gemara there seeks to say that [the authority who holds], "One who lent on collateral is a paid bailee," holds in accordance with Rabbi Yitzchak. And our entire discussion regarding a gentile's chametz in the possession of an Israelite deals with [a case where] the Israelite did not accept financial responsibility for it; for had he accepted [responsibility], it would be considered his and he would transgress regarding it, as is demonstrated in the first chapter (5b).

Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:5:1.hebrew: ואם אמר הגעתיך עובר - לאביי, רישא מיירי כשפדאו; וסיפא, כי אמר "הגעתיך" — היינו שאינו רוצה לפדותו:
Tosafot on Pesachim 31b:5:1.english: "And if he said, 'I have made it yours,' he transgresses" - According to Abaye, the first clause is dealing with [a case] where [the gentile] redeemed it; and the latter clause, when he said, "I have made it yours" — that means that he does not want to redeem it.
